'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russia–Ukraine peace negotiations]], [[China and the Russo-Ukrainian war|China and the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[China]] unveils a 12-point position paper on ending the [[Russo-Ukrainian War|war]] in [[Ukraine]], ahead of an expected speech by [[President of China|President]] [[Xi Jinping]] on the conflict. Ukraine says that it hopes China can urge [[Russia]] to withdraw its [[Russian Ground Forces|troops]] in response to the paper. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/feb/24/china-calls-for-russia-ukraine-war-peace-talks (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Poland]] delivers the first [[Leopard 2]] [[main battle tank]]s to Ukraine. [https://www.dw.com/en/poland-delivers-first-leopard-tanks-to-ukraine/a-64809432 (DW)]
*[[Mali War]]
**Twelve people are killed in a [[mass shooting]] by [[insurgent]]s in a village in [[Bankass Cercle]], [[Mopti Region]], [[Mali]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-kill-least-12-civilians-central-mali-village-2023-02-24/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Global spread of H5N1]]
**[[Cambodia]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Cambodia)|Ministry of Health]] reports 12 more suspected cases of [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N1|H5N1 influenza]] in [[Prey Veng province]] following the death of a 12-year-old girl, the first confirmed death from the virus since 2014.
